page.overview:
Who is Y'shtola Rhul?

Y'shtola Rhul , also known as Master Matoya, is a character in Final Fantasy XIV, introduced as the Scions of the Seventh Dawn representative for players who start in Limsa Lominsa and appears throughout subsequent expansions as an ally of the Warrior of Light. In version 1.0, Y'shtola appeared at the beginning of the Lominsan questline, where she helped the adventurer during the aurelia attack on the ship.

Although Y'shtola's role in the main scenario is shared with the Warrior of Light's allies, she is frequently the main representative for Final Fantasy XIV in crossover titles that feature protagonists across the Final Fantasy series.

Y'shtola came from the Sharlayan colony in the Dravanian Hinterlands. She was one of twelve daughters of Y'rhul Nunh, and had eleven sisters and half-sisters. She was not close with many of her half-siblings as they all lived elsewhere, due to her father being a gleaner for Sharlayan and traveling often. Y'shtola had two younger full-blooded siblings, the twins Y'mhitra and Y'mallibo, but their birth greatly weakened their mother and left her frail. With her mother unable to care for children, the Forum intervened and put Y'shtola in the custody of Archon Matoya when she was seven years old, who trained Y'shtola as an apprentice. As a result of this separation from her family, her younger sisters, Y'mhitra and Y'mallibo, became just as distant to Y'shtola as her half-sisters.

Fifteen years before A Realm Reborn, the threat of the Garlean Empire prompted the colonists to abandon Dravania and return to the Sharlayan motherland. Every member of the colony except for Matoya left the Dravanian Hinterlands and sailed north, including Y'shtola who was seventeen at the time. At this point she began working on becoming an Archon herself.
